pixel_origin: top-left, y down; values in final-image pixels
projection: true isometric orthographic; camera looks along (-1,+1,-1) from the (+X,-Y,+Z) corner; drive front is -Y (lower-left on screen), its +X side faces lower-right

footprint_floor.note: drive body (shell) footprint on the floor plane z=0, tray excluded; left/right as seen when facing the drive front

tray_footprint_floor.note: open tray outline dropped straight down onto z=0 (part of it falls below the image)

scale.note: model mm; a 1 mm step along X, Y or Z spans px_per_mm_along_each_world_axis pixels

screen_axes.note: pixel offset of a 1 mm step along each world axis; +Y runs from the drive front to its rear (the tray comes out along -Y)

features_px.note: LED and eject button sit behind the open tray in this view (not visible)

render.engine: Cycles, emission-only toon fill, image-space outlines

tray_slide_note: add tray_slide_px * t (t = 0 open .. 1 closed) to the position of the tray layers to close the tray; the layers are rendered at t = 0

front_plane_px.note: bezel front plane (y = 80.50 mm) at the tray's mid height (z = 47.02 mm), at the left and right ends of the tray slot (x = -66.60 / 66.60 mm)

bezel_thickness_note: screen offset of the tray front plate's thickness (2.98 mm) along -Y; closed, the plate sits flush in the slot from the front plane 2.98 mm inward; the slot itself is a 2.00 mm deep tunnel in the bezel

slot_px.note: tray slot opening on the bezel front plane (rounded corners, r ~1.5 mm, ignored)

tray_clip.note: fixed screen-space clip for the tray layers at ANY slide position (clip-path in canvas pixels; it does not move with the tray): left of the vertical through the slot's top-right corner and below the slot's top edge line, both inset 0.5 px so the bezel outline stays whole. Tray outside the drive always falls inside it; tray inside the drive is visible only through the slot, which is exactly this region. Draw: body layer, then the clipped tray layer on top.

disc.note: disc in burner_traydisc_*: label side up in the tray's 120 mm recess, tray open; centre_px is the centre of its top face

layers_note: transparent PNGs on the same 1600x1062 pixel grid as burner_<theme>.png. body = drive without tray/front plate; tray = tray + front plate, open; traydisc = open tray with one disc
layers_webp_note: lossless WebP copies of the layer PNGs (Pillow, lossless=True, method=6), pixel-identical where alpha > 0
